items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: The name 'Bradley' is mentioned only by the interviewer in a comparative question ('He played a sweeter tone than Bradley...'). The interviewee does not mention Bradley, nor does he confirm or deny knowing him, only responding to the comparison about the other musician's tone.

ctx.x: He was good musician. Good musician. Good reader, you know. He was loud too, you know. He liked to blow loud.
He played a sweeter tone than Bradley, I guess, did he?

Well, he had a little bit of tone, yeah, because he was taught, you know. He was a good teacher, you know. After he knew the fundamentals, you know, up to the horn, you know. Do you remember Joe Oliver? Well Joe come up, just like those other fellas, you know, starting out like that. I remember when I first saw him, I was playing with that Eagle band then. And we was playing on Rampart Street one night, just the trombones and the violin and the guitar and bass. So he came in this place with his horn, you know,…
